summary_1line: A discourse on realizing the inner Brahman through mental discipline precedes the court assembling to hear Arjuna’s message.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yogins meditate with eyes closed, perceiving a thumb-sized radiant spirit dwelling within the human heart.
The Kuru kings enter a vast white hall with a golden floor sprinkled with sandal-water and lined with ivory and marble seats.
Bhishma, Drona, Karna, and Duryodhana stride together into the gleaming court behind the blind king Dhritarashtra.
